source_prompt:
# Instructions for accurately reporting failed municipal water-quality tests to protect the public

1. Start with the inspection records.
2.
completion:
Pick a test that failed.
3. Look under "Method" to see whether it was bacteria, trihalomethanes (THM), haloacetic acid (HAA), lead, or something else.
4. If it was bacteria, skip steps 5a, 5b, 6, 7, 8, 9, and 10. Report the fact and circumstances of the violation. (More details below.)
5. If it was a test for trihalomethanes (THM), starting from that record try to trace all the tests backwards and forwards until you find the highest result. (More details below.)
6. If it was a test for haloacetic acid (HAA), starting from that record try to trace all the tests backwards and forwards until you find the highest result. (More details below.)
7. It could get complicated looking for highs and lows in THM and HAA
